constitutive_equations.expression: mu_diff = dB/dH; mu_sec = B/H with mu_sec(0) = dB/dH|0
w_co(H) = integral_0^H B(h) dh; w(B) = H B - w_co(H)

constitutive_equations.domain: linear recoil-line approximation before irreversible demagnetization

constitutive_equations.expression: J_bound_phi = (curl M)_phi = partial_z M_r - partial_r M_z
K_bound_phi = (M cross n)_phi = M_z n_r - M_r n_z

constitutive_equations.warning: bound magnetization current is not free current and must not be double-counted

nonlinear_curve_policy.data_domain: strictly increasing first-quadrant samples beginning at (0,0)
nonlinear_curve_policy.interpolation: interval-scale-normalized Fritsch-Carlson/Hyman-limited monotone piecewise cubic Hermite evaluated in Bernstein form
nonlinear_curve_policy.required_knot_property: strictly positive differential permeability; valid abrupt terminal data receives a positive shape-preserving endpoint limit rather than curve rejection
nonlinear_curve_policy.inverse: interval-local direct extended-range inversion for linear intervals; Decimal safeguarded Newton/bisection for nonlinear intervals with stopping on reconstructed physical-H binary64 adjacency
nonlinear_curve_policy.endpoint_oracle: (0,0)->(binary64_max,binary64_max) maps B=2^-1074 to H=2^-1074 and B=2^-1073 to H=2^-1073 exactly
nonlinear_curve_policy.energy: direct positive integrals of B dH and H dB using normalized intervals; zero is returned only for a true nonnegative value below binary64 minimum subnormal; no HB-minus-coenergy cancellation

demagnetization_policy.screen: opposing local H projected against magnetization direction compared with Hci(T)
demagnetization_policy.invalid: temperature outside validity interval or opposing H >= Hci(T)
demagnetization_policy.claim_limit: screening only; requires worst-case local operating field and does not predict irreversible state

permanent_magnet_representation.rule: exactly one authority per permanent-magnet material in a solver handoff
permanent_magnet_representation.equivalent_current_host: linear isotropic region with relative permeability exactly matching the permanent-magnet recoil relative permeability
permanent_magnet_representation.equivalent_current_source: constructed from the typed permanent-magnet material, in-range temperature, and direction; M is derived as Br(T)/mu0 and cannot be independently supplied
permanent_magnet_representation.axis_regularity: radial magnetization is forbidden on regions touching r=0

open_boundary_policy.method: finite-box truncation accepted only with geometric padding, low boundary field, and repeated domain-expansion QoI convergence
open_boundary_policy.claim_limit: finite-domain convergence evidence, not an exact infinite boundary
